title: Kɔkɔbɔ Ketekete Bi Ansa na Ɔhɔho Bi a Ɔrekɔ March
intro: Fa wo nan si bon bi a sodifo bi a ɔyɛ den ne ɔsraani dɔm kɛse bi rebɛn mu mu, na fa w’adwene bu ɔkwantufo ketewaa bi a ɔde kɔkɔbɔ bi rema a egye mpɔtam hɔfo nyinaa nkwa. Bere a mpɔtam hɔfo a wɔrehunahuna wɔn no du baabi a wɔbɛda no, asiane no twam. Di nsɛnkyerɛnne no akyi na hu onipa a wobu ani gu so wɔ saa kɔkɔbɔ no akyi.
clues: Meka abɔde nketewa a wɔde wɔn ho abɔ sodifo ahenni ho no ho.
Me mpɔtam hɔfo te atrae a ɛwɔ bon bi mu, baabi a yɛn mu biako betumi afrɛ afoforo no.
Yehyia ahunahuna a efi saa sodifo no ne asraafo a wɔne sodifo no retu kwan no hɔ.
Me ne deɛ mefrɛ me mpɔtam hɔfoɔ sɛ wɔmmra wɔn atraeɛ na mebɔ yɛn kɔkɔ sɛ ɛnsɛ sɛ wɔbubu yɛn a yɛnnim.
Sodifoɔ no ne Sulayman, na me su ka abɔdeɛ a wɔde wɔn ahyɛ n’ahyɛdeɛ ase no ho.
Mene saa bon no mu ntɛtea; me kɔkɔbɔ akyi no, yɛhyɛn yɛn atrae ahorow mu na yeguan fii abubuw a anka ɛbɛkyere yɛn a yennim no mu.

arabic: وَمَا كُنتَ تَتْلُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِۦ مِن كِتَـٰبٍۢ وَلَا تَخُطُّهُۥ بِيَمِينِكَ ۖ إِذًۭا لَّٱرْتَابَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
verse: And you did not recite before it any scripture, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt. (29:48)
